statement: For a differentiable local generator G_R[epsilon], the possible obstruction is a finite-jet surface density k_R[delta Y,epsilon] on partial Sigma.
derivation: delta G_R[epsilon]=bulk constraint variation + integral_partialSigma k_R[delta Y,epsilon]; Q_R is chosen to cancel or own this term.
claim_scope: sets the problem; does not prove silence

statement: If epsilon_R and all finite jets entering k_R vanish on an open collar of partial Sigma, every local boundary monomial containing epsilon_R or its jets vanishes pointwise.
derivation: support(epsilon_R) compactly contained in Sigma implies epsilon_R|partialSigma = nabla^a epsilon_R|partialSigma = 0 for required finite derivative order a.

statement: Under QRK2245_1, Q_R[epsilon]=integral_partialSigma q_R[epsilon]=0 and delta Q_R[epsilon]=0.
derivation: q_R and delta q_R are finite-jet local surface expressions in epsilon_R and fields; the epsilon_R jet factors vanish on the boundary collar.
claim_scope: kills representative edge charge for compact local gauge variations, not physical source or large transformations

statement: Under QRK2245_1 for both epsilon_R and eta_R, K_boundary[epsilon,eta]=0 for any finite-jet local boundary cocycle.
derivation: the cocycle is a surface bilinear in the generators and finite jets; every boundary term contains a vanished generator jet.
claim_scope: compact proper algebra closes with zero boundary cocycle

statement: The proper-R_AB zero does not erase observed ADM/time/rotation or GR Hamiltonian charges.
derivation: the vanishing condition applies to representative R_AB parameters only; physical Hamiltonian generators remain in the observed boundary sector.
claim_scope: prevents deleting GR charges to save the MTS branch

statement: The compact/proper lemma does not prove Q_R=0 for source worldtubes, large transformations, reference-boundary terms, or range-kernel weighted edge projections.
derivation: R10 and local source tests can involve nonzero boundary/support data; those terms are exactly the retained residual rows.

statement: Q_R=0 and K_boundary=0 are derived only for the proper compact representative sub-branch.
derivation: QRK2245_1 through QRK2245_4 close the narrow boundary algebra, while QRK2245_5 blocks promotion to R10/local-GR.
claim_scope: useful GR-reduction hygiene, not an empirical pass
